people.name: Philip
people.line: One of the seven deacons, evangelized in Samaria

translations.web: The multitudes listened with one accord to the things that were spoken by Philip when they heard and saw the signs which he did.
translations.bsb: The crowds all paid close attention to Philip’s message and to the signs they saw him perform.
translations.kjv: And the people with one accord gave heed unto those things which Philip spake, hearing and seeing the miracles which he did.
translations.asv: And the multitudes gave heed with one accord unto the things that were spoken by Philip, when they heard, and saw the signs which he did.
